title: m3flow artifact type pack (types/v1)
description: Declarative extension of the artifact type hierarchy. Each entry names a new type and its parent; the parent must be a builtin type or one defined earlier in the merged view. Redefining a known type is an error.

pack.description: Pack name for diagnostics, e.g. atomicsim.

types.description: NewTypeName: ParentTypeName. Family is inherited from the parent chain.
